display_fil: Kaso: Pagkatapos ng pagkahulog, dumating ang health worker
display_en: Case: After a fall, another health worker arrives
narration_fil: Pagkatapos ng pagkahulog, dumating ang isa pang health worker. Hawak ni BHW Lea ang facts sa lugar, oras, nakitang kondisyon at natawag na tulong.
narration_en: After a fall, another health worker arrives. BHW Lea has the scene facts, timeline, observed condition and help already called.

display_fil:
Sitwasyon, nakitang tugon at paghinga
Oras, ginawa, pagbabago at kailangang tulong
Kumpirmahing narinig ang agarang alalahanin
Itala lamang ang kinakailangang facts
display_en:
Situation, observed response and breathing
Key timeline, actions taken, changes, support needed
Confirm the receiver heard the urgent concern
Document only factual, necessary details
narration_fil: Sabihin ang sitwasyon, tugon at paghinga, oras, ginawa, pagbabago at kailangang tulong. Kumpirmahing narinig ang agarang alalahanin at itala lamang ang kinakailangang facts.
narration_en: State the situation, observed response and breathing, key timeline, actions taken, changes and support needed. Confirm the receiver heard the urgent concern and document only factual, necessary details.

display_fil:

What is the first response?
Choose before reading the explanation.

check.prompt_fil: Kararating lang ng health worker. Ano ang una mong sasabihin?
check.prompt_en: The health worker has just arrived. What do you say first?

options.fil: Ang hula mo kung ano ang nabali.
options.en: Your guess about what is broken.

options.fil: Ang buong kuwento mula sa simula.
options.en: The whole story from the beginning.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Tama. Unahin ang sitwasyon at oras, saka ang tugon, paghinga at ginawa. 2: Huwag magdagdag ng hinulaang diagnosis. Iulat ang nakita mo. 3: Kailangan muna ng tatanggap ang agarang facts ayon sa ayos ng job aid, hindi ang buong kuwento.
check.feedback_en: 1: Correct. Start with the situation and the time, then the response, breathing and actions. 2: Do not add a guessed diagnosis. Report what you saw. 3: The receiver needs the urgent facts first, in the job aid order, not the whole story.

narration_fil: Piliin muna ang sagot. Pagkatapos, basahin ang paliwanag sa bawat pagpipilian.
narration_en: Choose an answer first. Then read the explanation for each option.

display_fil:
Ano ang nangyari, at kailan
Nakitang tugon at paghinga; ginawa; natawag na tulong
Walang hinulaang diagnosis
Pinakukumpirma ni Lea ang susunod na hakbang
display_en:
What happened, and when
Response and breathing seen; actions; help called
No guessed diagnosis
Lea asks the receiver to confirm the next action
narration_fil: Pagdating ng health worker, sinasabi ni Lea ang nangyari at kailan. Iniuulat niya ang nakitang tugon at paghinga, ang ginawa, at ang natawag na tulong. Sinasabi rin niya ang pagbabago at kailangang tulong. Hindi siya nanghuhula ng diagnosis. Hinihiling niyang kumpirmahin ng tatanggap ang agarang alalahanin at susunod na hakbang. Itinatala lamang niya ang kinakailangang facts.
narration_en: When the health worker arrives, Lea says what happened and when. She reports the response and breathing she observed, what she has done, the help already called, any changes, and the support needed. She gives no guess about the injury. She asks the receiver to confirm the urgent concern and the next action, and records only the facts needed.

display_fil:
Huwag magdagdag ng hinulaang diagnosis
Huwag kaligtaan ang oras o ginawa
Huwag ibahagi ang detalye sa labas ng handover
display_en:
Do not add a guessed diagnosis
Do not omit the time or actions
Do not share identifiable details outside the care handover
narration_fil: Huwag magdagdag ng hinulaang diagnosis, kaligtaan ang oras o ginawa, o ibahagi ang detalye sa labas ng handover.
narration_en: Do not add a guessed diagnosis, omit the time or actions, or share identifiable details outside the care handover.

display_fil:
Ano ang susunod na hakbang?
Subukan bago tingnan ang paliwanag.
display_en:
What is the next step?
Try before viewing the explanation.

check.prompt_fil: Paano dapat tapusin ang handover mo sa practice?
check.prompt_en: How should your practice handover end?

options.fil: Ikuwento rin sa mga nakikiusyoso sa paligid ang lahat ng iniulat.
options.en: By telling the bystanders everything you just reported.

options.fil: Sabihin ang sarili mong hula kung bakit siya nahulog.
options.en: With your own guess about what caused the fall.

options.fil: Hilinging kumpirmahin ng tatanggap ang susunod na hakbang.
options.en: By asking the receiver to confirm the next step.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Huwag ibahagi ang detalye sa labas ng handover. 2: Hindi fact ang hula sa sanhi. Iulat lamang ang nakita at ginawa mo. 3: Tama. Tinatapos ang handover sa paghiling na kumpirmahin ng tatanggap ang susunod na hakbang.
check.feedback_en: 1: Do not share identifiable details outside the care handover. 2: A guessed cause is not a fact. Report only what you saw and did. 3: Correct. Inviting the receiver to confirm the next action closes the handover.

narration_fil: Balikan ang kuwento. Piliin ang angkop na susunod na hakbang.
narration_en: Return to the story. Choose an appropriate next step.

narration_fil: Sa Lunes, gamitin ang kaparehong checklist sa bagong kathang-isip na kaso. Itala ang nakita at kung sino ang tatawagan. Magbigay ng factual na handover na may oras at hilinging kumpirmahin ng tatanggap ang susunod na hakbang.
narration_en: On Monday, use the same checklist with a new fictional case. Record observations and the confirmed contact. Deliver a timed, factual handover and invite the receiving worker to confirm the next action.
